deploy-bot: PROD push started — env=prod-us-west2, target=production, tag=v3.5.0, commit=`a1b2c3d4e5f6`, initiated by @marisa. Change window 22:00-01:00 UTC. Canary traffic: 5%. Pins: inference-runtime=kernel-opt-v5, quant_profile=q4_opt_v2.
marisa: Starting canary now. I'll watch latency, errors, and token throughput. ping @logan for infra checks.
logan: Got it — watching GPU pool, autoscaler, and node health. Will call out if we see OOMs or throttling.
devin: Note: I pinned model-prod quantization to `q4_opt_v2` as part of the promote to avoid perf regressions. Tests looked good locally.
deploy-bot: Canary at 5% — health checks passing (latency p95 stable). Bumping to 50% in 3m.
ci-monitor-bot: Alert: +0.8% 5xx spike on /v1/generate at 00:12 UTC localized to shard s3. Beginning automated drain of affected instance.
marisa: Thanks for the alert. Logan — can you confirm drain and replace the instance? Hold further traffic shift until cleared.
logan: Instance drained. Restarted serving with fallback flag `--kernel-compat=1` on that node. Telemetry back to baseline in the last 2 minutes.
deploy-bot: Canary cleared. Proceeding to 50% -> 100% traffic shift.
deploy-bot: Traffic shift to 100% complete — tag promoted to v3.5.0, commit `a1b2c3d4e5f6` pinned. Release duration: 18m. Notes: quant profile pinned; kernel fallback applied to one node during canary. :shipit: :tada:
alex: Adding a short blurb to the changelog and scheduling customer comms for 09:00 PT tomorrow.
devin: Running post-deploy smoke evals against representative prompts — all checks green. Logging results to the release doc.
marisa: Great job everyone. I'll open a follow-up thread with perf numbers and the rollout checklist (including the kernel-compat note) for the on-call handoff.
